info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Message threads API

items.docs: Get all message threads that you have created, filtered by time interval and/or specific message thread IDs. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Creates a new [Message thread](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/#message-thread) on behalf of the specified customer, i.e. the sender of the original message in the message thread.
